rules.name: fec_committee_id_match
rules.description: Donor's fec_contributions_raw.committee_id is one of the curated defense-contractor PACs (verified via fec.gov, listed below). Confidence: high in principle, but in this run the only rule-1 hits arrive via a fuzzy-name-matched donor whose contributions are tagged with a different city, so the single rule-1 finding is downgraded to low + sensitive.

rules.name: employer_match
rules.description: donor_identities.canonical_employer or fec_contributions_raw.fec_employer matches a defense-contractor token: lockheed, boeing, northrop, raytheon, rtx, general dynamics, l3harris, bae systems, booz allen, leidos, saic, mitre, palantir, anduril, honeywell aerospace (NOT bare 'honeywell'), caci. Special-case: 'southwest research' / 'swri' is a 501(c)(3) research institute with substantial DoD-funded dual-use research; any match is flagged sensitive=true. Confidence: medium with corroborating signal, low alone.

rules.name: occupation_match
rules.description: fec_occupation contains 'AEROSPACE ENGINEER', 'DEFENSE CONTRACTOR', 'MILITARY OFFICER (RETIRED)' etc. Used as low-confidence corroboration only; never alone. (No findings rest solely on this rule in this run.)

findings.label: Possible Defense Industry Donor (General Dynamics PAC) - UNVERIFIED, identity collision
findings.notes: Donor 'Dean, Thomas' (San Antonio 78207, $200 to D6 Galvan) was matched by the FEC enrichment pipeline to multiple Thomas Dean / Deane / Deans contributors nationwide. The two contributions to General Dynamics PAC (C00078451), totalling $60, are tagged 'FT WORTH DIV GENERAL DYNAMICS' as employer with city Fort Worth, TX - almost certainly a different person at the GD Fort Worth Division (sold to Lockheed in 1993). Other matched contributions span 'American Materials & Lumber Sales', 'ARMY', 'RETIRED Engineer', 'Real Estate', etc., showing clear national fuzzy-match noise. The SA Thomas Dean has no self-reported employer in the SA campaign-finance row. Flagged sensitive=true so a human can decide whether to publish the GD-PAC association at all and whether to re-run the FEC match with stricter zip / city filters. total_amount reflects the rule-1 PAC-contribution sum but should NOT be presented as proof the SA donor gave to GD.
